notes.title: V1.0.3 Tips for Customization
notes.content:
[h2]1) To select card set and game variant, first click the [b]Rules[/b] button above, before starting a game

2) If you want to play with classic card images, deactivate "[b]Colored cards[/b]" option. You can define special cards then just the way you like to play the game!

3) Click [b]Options[/b] > [b]Settings[/b] (main menu) to select your favorite from 3 classic card sets![/h2]

notes.title: Release August 8th
notes.content:
